Note: the earlier attempt used `switch`, `router`, and `link` — none of which exist as openers in the `topology` genre (all nine errors are "not allowed in genre topology", i.e., unrecognized keywords, not malformed arguments). Topology's vocabulary is generic: nodes and edges, with role/meaning carried by the label text and `class`, not by a per-device-type keyword. I don't have a live validator in this session, so I can't confirm this renders clean — I'm applying the documented pattern (closed grammar, `class` for meaning, quoted labels, bare ids) as best I can without the genre file in hand. Treat this as a best-effort repair, not a confirmed pass.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

class wan "WAN uplink" stroke=#2563eb
class backup "Backup path" stroke=#dc2626 style=dashed

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Primary Hub Router"
node hubbackup "Backup Hub Router"

edge access1 branch
edge access2 branch
edge branch hubprimary class=wan
edge branch hubbackup class=wan,backup
```

What changed and why:
- `switch id "label"` / `router id "label"` → `node id "label"`: node-type keywords aren't part of the topology genre; the device role (access switch, branch router, hub router) is carried entirely in the quoted label, which is the honest place for it since no per-type opener exists.
- `link a b` → `edge a b`: same reasoning — `link` isn't a recognized opener; `edge` is the generic connector.
- Kept the two `class` declarations and their application to the two WAN edges (`hubprimary`, `hubbackup`) unchanged, including the dashed/red `backup` class stacked with `wan` on the backup link, since that meaning was correct and unaffected by the keyword errors.

Please run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js branch-wan-uplinks.fd` (or whatever you name it) to confirm — if `node`/`edge` aren't the actual topology keywords either, the error output will name the real ones and I'll do another bounded repair pass from that.
